_comment: Upgrades for the stainless plant only - they never affect the copper works. Same format as upgrades.json; 'unlock_at' counts money earned by this factory.

upgrades.name: Torque Tools
upgrades.desc: Calibrated power tools for the crew: every click does more work at each station.

upgrades.name: Mirror Finish
upgrades.desc: Electropolished shells and a premium badge. Installers pay more for them.

upgrades.name: Servo Conveyors
upgrades.desc: Servo-driven belts move heavy vessels between cells sooner.

upgrades.name: Bulk Steel Contract
upgrades.desc: Buy coil by the lorry-load. Every cylinder costs less in raw material.

upgrades.name: Energy Recovery
upgrades.desc: Recovers weld heat and argon. Cuts the cost of making each cylinder.

upgrades.name: Shift Supervisor
upgrades.desc: Keeps clicking worthwhile: each click also gives every machine a burst of extra output.

upgrades.name: Smart Factory Suite
upgrades.desc: Plant-wide scheduling software. Every machine in the plant runs faster.
